### 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature, tool, or enhancement you would like to see.

### ❓ Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear description of what the problem, frustration, or limitation is. (e.g., *"I'm looking for a way to..."*)

### 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Implementation Idea
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision it working.

### 🧩 Component Impacted
Select which area this feature touches:
- [ ] Core MCP Server (`src/index.ts`)
- [ ] SQLite Storage & FTS5 Indexing (`src/db/`)
- [ ] Terminal CLI Utility (`cortex`)
- [ ] Configuration / PRAGMAs (`~/.cortexdb/config.json`)
- [ ] Documentation / Agent Protocols
- [ ] Other (please specify)

### 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, code mockups, or diagrams about the feature request here.
